evals.name: expensive-build-confirms
evals.prompt: /madness I've got a MISSION.md in here for a multi-service analytics dashboard (web + worker + a Postgres schema). Let's actually build the whole thing out with the agent team.
evals.expected_output: Routes to `orchestrator`, announces it as a multi-agent build, and CONFIRMS before launching. Does NOT start writing code or contracts itself.

evals.name: autonomous-loop-confirms
evals.prompt: /madness the test suite on this branch is a mess. I want something to just keep grinding on it until everything's green and lint passes — I'm going to bed.
evals.expected_output: Routes to `loop-controller` (which selects fix-until-green), flags it as autonomous/overnight = expensive, and CONFIRMS before starting. Does not begin fixing tests inline.

evals.name: cheap-route-just-goes
evals.prompt: /madness this UI looks like every other generic shadcn admin dashboard. help me make it not.
evals.expected_output: Routes to `ui-brief` (then mentions frontend-design/frontend-agent as the follow-on build). Treats it as cheap and launches without a needless confirm. Hands off rather than redesigning inline.

evals.name: browsing-hands-to-explorer
evals.prompt: /madness honestly I don't even remember what I've got for testing and QA stuff. what's in here?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as browsing/orientation, hands to `skill-explorer` (or answers the catalog inline) and does NOT launch any heavy workflow. No confirm gate needed.

evals.name: vague-coldstart-shows-menu
evals.expected_output: Bare invocation with no intent: shows the short front-door menu and asks which door, rather than guessing a heavy route. Keeps the menu to front doors, not all 60 skills.
